# Gregory Lang — Director of Development (DEPARTED)

- **Status:** **Departed Keystone on 2026-04-30.** Left to lead development at a larger arts
  nonprofit. Amicable exit.
- **Former role:** Director of Development — owned grants and major gifts before
  [Daniela Cruz](daniela-cruz.md) succeeded him. Do **not** route fundraising asks to Gregory; he
  is no longer at Keystone.
- **Backfill:** the **Development Associate** seat under him is still **OPEN**; Daniela is covering
  and hiring the replacement (see [commitments](../commitments.md)).

## Handover notes (for continuity)
- Held the early [Hearthstone renewal](../projects/hearthstone-grant.md) conversations; his
  "verbally committed" read from spring did **not** hold — the grant was later declined. Don't rely
  on his optimistic notes.
- Introduced Keystone to major donor [Sarah Whitman](sarah-whitman.md); that relationship now sits
  with Daniela.
